findings.title: Describe the required Tier 4 walkthrough
findings.body: The owner following these release notes sees only “Tier 4 pending (mini)” without instructions or expected results. This omits all four acceptance observations: Compact makes every card one line, the demo Backlog fits the window, Comfortable restores two lines, and the selected density survives a relaunch. Pending execution is acceptable; the missing walkthrough is the defect.
findings.fix: Keep Tier 4 marked pending and add steps on the mini to select Compact and verify one-line cards and the demo Backlog fitting the window, select Comfortable and verify two-line cards return, then quit and relaunch to verify the selected density persists.
